notes.title: 1.0.3 patch notes.
notes.notes:
• Bugfix: Added better error handling to the Void Runs which was preventing Valazeus from dying.
• Bugfix: Kaboom perk wasn't registering enemy kills which could prevent decreasing enemie kill counts during some game modes.
• Bugfix: Grant additional achievements for completing story mode for difficulties lower than the one the player completes. This should apply retroactively.
• Bugfix: Players are now awarded the total number of missing skill points after reaching 30+100 to unlock all perks.
• Bugfix: Levelling up multiple times no longer causes missing level-up rewards. Now combines the rewards even if you level up multiple times.
• Bugfix: Unlocking NPCs in the Codex is fixed.
• Bugfix: Chaotic mask now drops in the Underworld.
• Bugfix: Reload speed min time clamped to 0 seconds to prevent negative values. Also fixes bug with tiny reload times not reloading the weapon.
• Bugfix: Sometimes bullets would fire in the wrong direction when starting a run.
• Bugfix: Added a button cooldown for the alert popup on the Bounties and Apply Spray menus.
• Bugfix: Pressing confirm without a spray selected will no longer bring up the confirmation dialog.

• Changed: Blitz Mode doesn't end immediately allowing you to grab your loot.
• Changed: Increase the XP required to get to grit level 100.
• Changed: Spawn logic for Assault Mode will now make sure there are always enough enemies to complete a wave.

notes.title: 1.0.2 patch notes.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a game breaking bug that prevented loading your save game when you reached Level 30 / Grit Level 100.
[*] Grant 3 additional skills points at level 30.
[*] Show the Load Game button on the Main Menu when the player has one or more save files.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
We have officially exited Early Access with our 1.0 update that adds the single player story campaign to the game. We've also added 3 difficulty modes, achievements, Steam Deck support, and did some rebalancing.

It's been a long road for our small team to get here, but we are finally over the finish line and we are thrilled to deliver our vision for the Deadtime Defenders experience to everyone.

notes.title: Exiting Early Access on Thursday
notes.notes:
Thursday we will be exiting Early Access with our 1.0 update that adds the single player story campaign to the game. We've also added 3 difficulty modes, achievements, Steam Deck support, and did some rebalancing.

It's been a long road for our small team to get here, but we are finally over the finish line and we are thrilled to deliver our vision for the Deadtime Defenders experience to everyone.

notes.title: Discord and Preview Access to Story Mode
notes.notes:
It's what you've all been waiting for!

After a few months of effort by our team - we nearly have the preview version of the story mode update ready for feedback and player testing!

In order to better handle feedback, this is the perfect time to announce our Discord which you can join here: [url=https://discord.gg/Z8s2DFWXFV]https://discord.gg/Z8s2DFWXFV[/url]

So how do you get to play the story mode? We'll be inviting some members from the Discord community to participate in a beta branch. Join the Discord for your chance to play the update before we go live.

Over and out.

notes.title: Story Mode Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Defenders!

We wanted to give an update on the Story Mode since it's taking longer than anticipated.

The story’s script has been written, we’ve coded a new system to track progress throughout the campaign, and we've created some brand-new game modes you’ll be playing that support the story.

We're currently glueing all these new pieces together so that we can begin play-testing to refine the balance and difficulty soon.

That’s it for now, and more updates to come!

As you were, Defenders.

HUAH!

notes.title: New Reduced Price
notes.notes:
Attention, all monster-mashers, creature-killers, and [i]financially savvy[/i] gamers!

Gear up, grab your guns and join the fight at [u][b]a new low price[/b][/u] because The Deadtime Defenders need you now more than ever!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible

We’re excited to announce that we’ve completed the steps to ensure Deadtime Defenders plays great on the Steam Deck. The war against Valazeus and his minions is [i]literally[/i] in the palm of your hands. Now you can bring your Defender anywhere!

[*] Steam Cloud for game saves.
[*] Showing the Steam Deck glyphs in the menus.
[*] Support for native resolution 1280x800.
[*] UI/UX improvements for the Steam Deck.

[/list]

Drop a comment below if you plan to take your Defender on the go!

[b]Over and out.[/b]

notes.title: Abandoned No More
notes.notes:
Greetings, Defenders! Whether you're a veteran of the Void or a new recruit ready to save the world, we can't wait to pull back the curtain and share what's happening with the beloved monster-hunting looter shooter, Deadtime Defenders!

Back in 2020, the game's previous studio made some tough decisions to halt development, and our squad of intrepid soldiers were left for dead behind enemy lines. However, in early 2024, the newly formed Arcane Embers studio [i](that's us!)[/i] put a plan in place to rescue the Defenders and bring them back home ... your home!

[b]That's right, Deadtime Defenders is back![/b]

[h3]What does this mean?[/h3]
As fellow fans of the game, we played countless hours and pored over user reviews to figure out what was working and what could use some TLC. So over the coming weeks, you'll see a stream of patch updates that contain gameplay improvements, quality-of-life fixes, and bug fixes. We'll also be releasing an update that makes the game run great on [b]Steam Deck[/b] so you can defend [b]anytime[/b], [b]anywhere[/b].

[h3]Story Mode - Coming Soon[/h3]
We've begun working on a [b]Story Mode[/b] that provides narrative driven ways to experience the game while blasting monsters in their ugly monster faces. We'll be introducing some new modes and gameplay mechanics so you'll be able to call down the thunder with support from AI teammates, rescue civilians, and repair field equipment vital to the mission on your new and improved journey to the Void.

[h3]Dive In[/h3]
Purchase Deadtime Defenders today or add us to your Wishlist on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148700/Deadtime_Defenders/

[b]Stay frosty, Defenders![/b]

notes.title: Update 10 - Rescue Mode
notes.notes:
A new game mode appears: Rescue! You'll have to eliminate a set number of enemies and then break open the Crystal to save a survivor in this game mode!

[h2]Rescue Mode[/h2]
We are currently working on the tech changes required to add story mode to the game. One of the things we'll be adding for the story is having to complete rescue missions to unlock specific NPCs instead of "level locking" them. This is our first iteration of this new game mode that will be hooked into the mission system in a future update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/rescue_mode1.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/rescue_mode3.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/rescue_mode2.png[/img]


[h2]Game Improvements[/h2]
We've improved the graphics for the Void and Rescue mode Crystal and added some VFX when destroying it. This update also includes some performance fixes, an improved Run Complete menu, and some Void Run improvements.


[h2]Chat on Discord[/h2]
Be sure to join our Discord to chat with the community and provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• A new game mode: Rescue! Eliminate a bunch of enemies and then break the Crystal to save a random NPC inside!
• New graphics for the Void Crystal.
• Rock and crystal debris (with screen shake) when breaking open the Crystal in a Rescue or Void Run.
• After completing a Void Run you must enter the portal to the right like the other game modes.
• Added a FTUE for the Crafting menu.
• New Run Complete menu with a separate page showing the loot found.
• Improved the performance related to the gib and debris emitters.
• Improved the performance for graphics sorting and our custom simulated 3D objects.

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
• Destroying a Crystal (Rescue or Void Run) yields crystal rewards.
• Made the play area for the Void zone smaller.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed another bug that to make sure Apex items roll at level 30.
• Fixed a bug with the screen shake not clamping to map bounds.
• Fixed the background size aspect ratio for Loadout menu.
• Typo fixes in the HQ first-time user experience.

notes.title: Update 9 - Crafting Update!
notes.notes:
We have ANOTHER BIG update available today! CRAFTING has been added to Deadtime Defenders!

[h2]Crafting[/h2]
You can now craft health packs, grenades, molotovs, and a bunch of explosives! Find the blueprint for each item as a drop in game to learn the recipe. Gather up enough materials to create the item. Visit Mac in the HQ at the crafting table and he'll help you craft the gadget. Equip these gadgets in your Loadout and take them on your missions!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/crafting_update_1.png[/img]


[h2]Game Improvements[/h2]
We've cranked up visuals throughout the game, and improved a bunch of the menus. We also added a bunch of QoL fixes and improved the balancing some more. The biggest balancing change is that explosives now do self-damage. Be careful out there!

[h2]NEW TRAILER![/h2]
We've refreshed our Steam page with new descriptions, screenshots, and a brand spanking new trailer! Check it out and let us know what you think in the comments!

[previewyoutube=I_tvfhhLoq8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Chat on Discord[/h2]
Be sure to join our Discord to chat with the community and provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]


[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• CRAFTING! Create health packs, grenades, molotovs, and explosives to help you on your runs!
• Player now teleports in / out of the Zones.
• Added explosion flash VFX to rockets and grenades showing area of influence.
• Added a bunch of new hair / beard colors to the Character Creator.
• Players can mouse click the portal in the HQ to open up the Zone Select menu.
• Added new and improved art assets for the Giant Toad in the Bayou.
• Added particles, improved art, and visual polish to all zones.
• Added a parallax effect to the new foreground layer in zones.
• Added a new shadow sprite for entities.
• Changed Talents to Augments to better fit the theme of the game.
• Adjusted the beam colors for loot drops.
• Zoomed the camera out a bit to show a bit more gameplay area.
• Berzerker perk has a particle system when activated.
• Increased the screen shake VFX when finding loot.
• Improved the layout of the HQ to accommodate two new vendors: Snips and Mac.

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
• Explosives and explosive weapons now cause self-damage. Take care when firing them now!
• Shotgun close range damage increased.
• Blitz Mode now unlocks at level 3 and not level 10.
• Reduced the drop rate of med-kits.
• Scrapping items now yields crafting materials instead of giving the player nothing.
• Cyclone (mini-gun) won't roll the Lucky One talent anymore.
• Snapper won't roll the Lucky One talent anymore.

[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
• Changed Zone Select title to Run Setup.
• Big improvements to the visuals of the Weapon Spray menu.
• Added a visual preview of the current weapon spray at the bottom of the weapons details card.
• Added a Vault menu upgrades panel to upgrade the available vault space.
• Added particle effect to the Run Setup menu.
• Added an indicator to the HUD for Weapons and Gadgets to show which key will activate it.
• Reduced the size of the timer display on the Crystal Boss.
• Reduced the size of elements on the Run Complete menu.
• Reduced the size of the NPC dialog box.
• Reduced the size of the Ravenous Games logo during the splash screen.
• Reduced the size of the buttons in the Recalibration station.
• Reduced the size of the Perk and Weapon slot selection menus.
• Reduced the size of the mouse cursor.
• Reduced the size of the rewards during the level up / over-level popup.
• Reduced the size of interaction text while interacting with NPCs in HQ.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that would allow Apex items to roll at anything less than level 30.
• Fixed a bug that caused items to disappear when buying or selling items at the vendor.
• Fixed a bug when unlocking new zones causing the highlighter to disappear when using a gamepad.
• Fixed a bug that could cause weapons to show their weapon skin correctly.
• Fixed a bug with 3:2 aspect ratio calculation.
• Fixed the layout / positioning of the background on the Character Creator menu and the Loadout menu.

notes.title: Update 8 - A new rarity appears! APEX items are now available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have a BIG update here - we added an BRAND NEW RARITY to the end-game for Deadtime Defenders!

APEX is a new rarity (red) available to players who've reached level 30. APEX weapons come with either 2 talents and 3 mod slots, or 1 talent and 4 mods slots. APEX costumes come with 2 talents. APEX mods, costumes, and weapons, all have increased stats. You can't buy APEX items, you must find them from looting.

We also added 4 new costume talents, fixed a ton of bugs, and improved more of the UI / UX.

We can't wait to hear what kind of dual talented items everyone finds!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/apex_update_1.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/apex_update_2.png[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord and chat with the community or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• Added a new rarity (red) for loot called APEX! Apex weapons can come with 2 talents or 4 mod slots, and Apex costumes come with 2 talents!
• Added new loot sound effects plus screen shake when loot appears.
• Added 4 new costume talents: Elite soldier, Quick Reloads, Paramedic and XP Boost.
• Display a shield around the player when invincibility is activated from perks.
• Selecting the player on the Loadout shows the costume details now.
• Players can now click on the player portrait in the HUD to open the backpack menu.
• Improved the UX in the weapon spray station menu by moving the equipped weapons to the top of the list.
• Display the weapon category on the Codex items.
• Display the location on the Codex items.
• Added sorting options to the Codex menu.
• Improved the layout of the Character Creator menu.
• Added button to the Pause Menu to bring up the Loadout screen.
• Added some explainer text to the recalibration station about what it does and how you can't re-roll APEX items.

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
• Increased the radius for nearby enemy detection for the Kaboom perk.
• Flamethrower won't roll the Explosive Bullets talent anymore.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed bugs that prevented weapon talents from working correctly.
• Fixed bugs that prevented costume talents from working correctly.
• Fixed a bug that wouldn't reset enemies invulnerable state which would make them impossible to kill.
• Fixed a bug that wasn't setting the player's health back to full when leveling up.
• Fixed a bug that would allow the display of the critical hit chance to be greater the 100% on a weapon.
• Fixed a bug that could cause the layout to happen incorrectly on the talent display box.
• Fixed a bug with the Kaboom perk.
• Fixed a bug with the Slugger perk.

notes.title: Update 7 - Over-levelling and improved UI!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've added some new end-game content in the form of over-levelling. When you reach the level cap of 30, you earn "grit levels". These are highlighted in the new and improved UI in this update. Grit levels provide MANY more hours of gameplay!

We've improved all the UI in the game and the most notable improved screens are the loadout menu and the HUD during gameplay. We've reduced the font size and the button size in almost all games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/new_hud.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/new_loadout_menu.png[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord and chat with the community or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• Added new OVER-LEVELLING system called - Grit Levels. After reaching the level cap of 30 you can continue to earn progress as you progress towards grit level 100.
• Improved the UI / UX in all menus.
• Improved the UI / UX during all game modes.
• Removed the weapon inspection menu and equip mods directly on the loadout menu.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that wasn't updating the high score for a Blitz Mode run.
• Fixed a bug with some of the keywords not getting highlighted correctly in menus.

notes.title: Update 6 - Recalibration Station
notes.notes:
Another week, another big update! The RECALIBRATION STATION is here! If you want a bit more control on the RNG in the game - this is the answer! You'll be able to re-roll item stats, upgrade item rarities, and re-roll Legendary weapon talents.

Visit Gizmo in the HQ and she'll help you recalibrate your items!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/recalibration_station_hq.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/recalibration_station.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/recalibration_station_reroll.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/recalibration_station_results.png[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord and chat with the community or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• RECALIBRATION STATION! Now you can re-roll stats, upgrade the rarity and re-roll weapon talents in the HQ.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that reloaded the ammo when switching to a new weapon.
• Fixed a bug that didn't cancel the reload immediately when switching to a new weapon.
• Fixed a bug with the reload indicator not filling the UI indicator from empty.
• Fixed a bug with adding and removing items from the Vault.
• Fixed a bug that caused players stats to be drawn outside the window in the Loadout Menu.
• Fixed a bug that didn't prompt player to save changes when clicking the back button in the Settings menu.
• Fixed a bug that showing a weapon has an equipped mod if the mod wasn't in the players inventory.

notes.title: Update 5 - Character Creator
notes.notes:
The CHARACTER CREATOR is here! Now you can personalize your character with a bunch of hair styles, facial features, hair colors, and skin tones.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/character_creator.png[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord and share your custom creations with us, to chat with the team, or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• The CHARACTER CREATOR is here! Now you can personalize your character with a bunch of hair styles, facial features, hair colors, and skin tones. 
• Added sound effects when putting items in or taking them out of the vault.
• Removed the enemy collider on the Crystal boss. Demons can now pass through it while chasing the player.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed the tech used to mask items in the backpack since it could cause issues with visual clipping.
• Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause items to get lost when transferring to or from the Vault.
• Fixed a bug that would allow the mini-boss Boulder to go invincible.
• Fixed a bug that required the vendor to have more then the amount needed to purchase an item.
• Fixed a bug that would allow the backpack items to be displayed with the incorrect height.
• Fixed a bug that would allow an item in the Vault to be displayed more than once.
• Fixed a bug that caused the currency display on the pause menu to be cut off.
• Fixed a bug with costume and weapon talent events being used for unequipped items.

notes.title: Update 4 - Vault Menu
notes.notes:
VAULT! No longer will you have to sell your excess gear to make room for new loot! A highly requested feature was added this update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/vault_menu.png[/img]

Visit Shade (a new NPC) in the HQ to stash and retrieve your gear!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/vault_shade.png[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord to chat with the team about the new update or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• Vaulting added! You can now store items in the Vault using a new NPC - Shade.
• Created new bounties for killing the mini-bosses.
• Improved the performance of any menus that contain loot.
• NPC's have their animation time randomized so that they don't all animate in sync.
• Updated two weapon skin names.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that would cause the audio to cut out when using melee weapons.
• Fixed a bug with the new mini-boss weapons not having any economy values.

notes.title: Mini-bosses
notes.notes:
Mini-bosses are here! Boulder, Snapjaw, Rog, Grim, Prawn and Bullseye are new high-value targets that you need to take out during Assault runs!

Each zone in Deadtime Defenders has a mini-boss that will randomly spawn for any players past level 5. Every mini-boss comes with their own unique item drops - a new weapon and costume.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/minibosses_snapjaw_attack.gif[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord to chat with the team about the new content or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• Mini-bosses: Boulder, Snapjaw, Rog, Grim, Prawn and Bullseye are new high-value targets that you need to take out during Assault runs!
• 6 new weapons and 6 new costumes you can earn from the mini-boss loot drops.
• Decreased the size of the mouse cursor.
• Renamed the Six-Shooter to the Sheriff since it doesn't always have six shots.

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
• Increased the difficulty of the enemies during the first few player levels since some players found the start of the game easy.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed a bug with some input devices (Razer Orbweaver, etc.) being detected as gamepad controllers.
• Fixed a bug with the weight of the Wasp. They shouldn't push enemies around as much.
• Added advanced diagnostics stored in game log should a player require support.

notes.title: Update 2 - Blitz Game Mode Added
notes.notes:
Ready to test your mettle? Fight an onslaught of enemies in the [b]NEW GAME MODE - BLITZ![/b] Enemies will keep coming at you until you can't handle it! There is a clock forcing you to keep your kills up, but you'll receive more rewards the more enemies you defeat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/update02_blitz_mode.png[/img]

The new game modes we added in Updates 1 & 2 should provide more variety in the gameplay for players working towards Level 30 and hitting the end-game!

Full patch notes below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/update02_level_select_blitz.png[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord to chat with the team about the new game mode or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• New game mode (Blitz) added!
• Added tutorials to new games modes.
• Renamed Waves mode to Assault.
• Enemies spawn closer to the edge of the screen increasing the pacing especially in Blitz mode.
• Stat display is rounded to two decimal places to improve readability in all menus.

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
• Added chance to find legendary items during all game modes when you reach level 25.
• Rebalanced item rarity drop rates in the late / end-game.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that allowed the Venus flytrap to not spawn correctly within the camera bounds.
• Fixed a bug with the ricochet talent not working when bullets hit the supply drop.
• Fixed a bug that would allow reload and magazine mods to be added to melee weapon.
• Fixed some bugs related to the enemy pathfinding in the Void.

notes.title: Update 1 - Defend Game Mode Added
notes.notes:
A supply drop has landed for the Deadtime Defenders and it's up to you to protect the shipment in the [b]NEW GAME MODE - DEFEND![/b] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/update01_defend_mode.png[/img]

You will have 90 seconds to keep the shipment in tip-top shape in order to receive the most amount of rewards. There are 3 stages of health for a shipment which will reward you 3, 2 or 1 steel crates when you successfully defend the supplies. You can use the repair rings to restore health back to the supply drop.

We've created a new level selection screen to help select different game modes plus we've done some rebalancing, bug fixes, and added some improvements. Full patch notes below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/update01_run_deploy.png[/img]

Be sure to join our Discord to chat with the team about the new game mode or provide feedback about the game!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

Progress on the mini-boss update is going well and we should be launching it on time later this month!

[h3]Features / Improvements[/h3]
• New game mode (Defend) added!
• New level selection screen added.
• Added an action in the weapon inspection screen to remove all mods at once.
• Implemented 8 new weapon sprays.
• Added confirmation alert when trying to sell equipped items.

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
• Weapon drop rate increased.
• Costume drop rate reduced.
• Ricochet bullets will only rebound a few times with reducing damage.
• Decreased Commando perk from 25% to 20%.
• Decreased Gunslinger perk from 25% to 20%.
• Decreased Slugger perk from 25% to 20%.
• Decreased Specialist perk from 25% to 20%.
• Increased max health of the Big Alien enemy.
• Reduced melee weapon damage.
• Reduced rocket launcher damage.
• There is now a slight chance that wood crates will spawn loot.
• Increased the collision size for the Wasp enemy.
• Increased the size of the crate collision box.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that prevented the correct hours played count from being displayed on a save slot.
• Fixed a bug that wasn't tracking the last wave being completed during a run.
• Removed the rarity display for a weapon spray in the item details box.
• Fixed bugs that caused bullets to not react correctly when hitting an enemy shield.
• Fixed a bug that prevented selecting categories in the Codex menu with the gamepad.

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap Revealed
notes.notes:
Now that we've launched Deadtime Defenders onto Steam - we want to share our roadmap with everyone for the features coming during Early Access in 2020!

We're very happy with our initial offering for Early Access, however, there are some really cool features coming up and we can't wait for you to be a part of it. We hope everyone is as excited as we are!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/roadmap.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1148700/extras/roadmap.jpg[/img][/url]

Be sure to join our Discord to chat with the team about the coming features and how you are enjoying the game so far! We'd love to hear what you're most excited about for our upcoming features!

[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord/[/url]

notes.title: One More Week!
notes.notes:
We are just a week away from launching into Early Access!

We need to get more Wishlist additions before launch. Our small team would really appreciate you spreading the word about it to your friends! Let them know about Deadtime Defenders. Sharing is caring!

Join our Discord if you want to see sneak peeks as we work on new features, or to get involved in development by providing feedback!

Our Discord community:
[url=http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord]http://deadtimedefenders.com/discord[/url]

notes.title: Deadtime Defenders is launching into Early Access on February 18!
notes.notes:
Deadtime Defenders is arriving on Steam Early Access on Tuesday, February 18th!

Who's ready to defeat some monster mobs and collect some sweet loot? Are you one of the few who will make it to the Void? What Legendary gear will you find?

So....how about an launch trailer?

[previewyoutube=CxRmhjOdrdo;full][/previewyoutube]

Soon you'll be able to play the game and share your progress with us and the community! We've already seen so many different play styles / strategies and can't wait to hear about your setup.
